The first-pass mapping under-classified: it tagged everything but two channels as identity, but reading the consumers shows two LIVE gameplay modifier families (combat percent + withdrawal flat) applied to the cargo unit while loaded (CvUnit.cpp:28842-28843 via processLoadedSpecialUnit, invoked at 17014/17050), PLUS a live world enabler (bValid -> makeSpecialUnitValid, CvGame.cpp:323/11616) and a live behaviour gate (bCityLoad, CvUnit.cpp:5650). CRITICAL SCOPE CORRECTION: the mapping puts iCombatPercent and iWithdrawalChange at scope=city; that is WRONG. Recommend authoring them under the entity's combat family with no city scope; the cascade target is the loaded unit, applied symmetrically on load(+1)/unload(-1).

Recommended approach: common-config. The surface is tiny (5 authored members + inherited Type/Description) and matches the standard primitive-channel + enabler + identity-flag shape that common-config handles; no hand-written FK vectors, no keyed-by-target edges OWNED by this entity, so a bespoke curator is unwarranted. NOT a POCO: it carries one live additive-style modifier (iCityDefenseModifier -> combat.city.defense.percent, CvCity.cpp:10184) and acts as a CONDITIONER/enabler that gates buildings (BuildingInfo.PrereqCultureLevel). It is a config/global entity in the GameSpeed/Handicap/Era family, so a BESPOKE curator (like curate_handicap.py / curate_gamespeed.py) is the right approach -- the SpeedThresholds collapse and the per-level caps are not standard cascade families and won't ride curate_common's channel machinery.

KEY VERDICTS / divergences from the first-pass mapping (mapping is a FILTER, not gospel -- under-classified again here):
1. Only ONE field is a true modifier family: iCityDefenseModifier (combat/defense, city, percent). Everything the mapping filed as a city/flat channel (iCityRadius, iMaxWorldWonders, iMaxTeamWonders, iMaxNationalWonders, iMaxNationalWondersOCC) is actually a NON-ADDITIVE replace/cap -> classifies OUT of the cascade as per-level IDENTITY (blueprint section 3: caps/overrides are not additive channels). Do not author them as flat families.
2. SpeedThresholds -> identity (base + per-speed overrides), per owner ruling section 7 line 1069. WATCH OUT: GameSpeed.cultureThresholdScalePercent referenced by that ruling DOES NOT EXIST yet (verified CvGameSpeedInfo has only iUnitYieldScalePercent) -- a future GameSpeed field to add in the reader/#430 phase; the collapse is a forward design, not an existing edge. Thresholds are raw culture points, NOT x100.
3. getLevel()/m_iLevel is runtime-derived (CvGlobals.cpp:3589) -> drop it.
4. PrereqGameOption is a whole-entity availability gate (policy/identity), the same field that computes the runtime active level.
5. ReplacementID/ReplacementCondition are NOT read by CvCultureLevelInfo -- they are the CvInfoReplacements conditional-whole-Info-replacement edge (the Trait-note discovery); LIVE (CULTURELEVEL_ALT_POOR), keep faithfully as a replacement edge, do NOT drop.

DOUBLE-AUTHOR / cross-entity edge to register: BuildingInfo has a PrereqCultureLevel field (Tools/Migration/mapping/BuildingInfo.json:173) -- a building gated by HAVING a culture level. Per the stay-vs-invert rule the culture level is the CONDITIONER (a gate you must possess, not a target the building modifies), so it INVERTS onto CultureLevel as enables.buildings, owned by the entity migrated FIRST (CultureLevel, a config entity, migrates before the Building monster). It is NOT yet wired: store.PREREQ_FIELDS (Tools/Migration/store.py:62-144) has no PrereqCultureLevel entry and CultureLevelInfo is not in store.ENTITIES. To wire: add CultureLevelInfo to ENTITIES and add ("BuildingInfo","PrereqCultureLevel","buildings") to PREREQ_FIELDS so the reverse enabler index attributes the punk/era buildings to their required culture level. No existing curate_*.py names CultureLevel, so there is no existing double-author to drop -- this is a NEW edge to add.

NO free-units-on-revolt or other per-level grant effects exist on this entity (checked all getters): the only per-level effects are the city-defense %, the workable-radius override, the four wonder caps, and the per-speed culture thresholds. iLevel is runtime-derived bookkeeping. Config/global-ish entity, ~19 records (CULTURELEVEL_NONE..MONUMENTAL plus the REALISTIC_SPREAD-gated and ALT_POOR-replacement rows).

RECOMMENDATION: bespoke curator -- this entity is unusual (a 'resolution' source whose effects deposit into game/team state and which couples to a not-yet-migrated VoteSource entity); it does not fit the pocos-config or common-config molds and needs explicit voteEffect-policy + two enabler-edge handling. isPoco=FALSE despite the first-pass mapping only declaring 2 channels (the spawnRate pair) — the POCO CAVEAT applies hard here. Reading the consumers shows CivilizationInfo actively GRANTS gameplay state at game start (FreeTechs -> setHasTech, FreeBuildings -> changeHasBuilding, InitialCivics -> setCivics), GATES capability (DisableTechs -> canEverResearch=false, bStronglyRestricted -> NPC build lockdown, bPlayable/bAIPlayable -> civ selection), DEPOSITS a real modifier family (spawnRate.empire.percent), and ENABLES the leader roster. So it is a SOURCE, not a pure data-holder.

Recommended approach: BESPOKE. common-config cannot express this entity: (1) the read() is heavily hand-written outside CvInfoUtil (CvWString descriptions, audio-tag-resolved sounds, the InitialCivics CivicOption-keyed array, the Cities string list, the pre-base ArtDefineTag merge) — see cpp:62-68 doc comment; (2) it carries three distinct grant edges with different landing scopes (team techs / city buildings / empire civics) that pocos-config/common-config buckets don't model; (3) getCheckSum is deliberately explicit (cpp:299-315) and order-sensitive for the asset checksum. A bespoke curate_civilization.py mirroring the curate_tech/civic precedent is the right call.

Key TRUE-scope corrections vs mapping/CivilizationInfo.json:

- FreeBuildings / FreeTechs / InitialCivics: mapping dumped all under 'identity'. They are GRANTS (live game-start state deposits), with scopes city / team / empire respectively. Not identity.

- bStronglyRestricted: not pure identity — it is a live empire-level NPC build-capability gate (CvCity.cpp:2205/2547); classified policy.
